intent: Build a tetris game with a high score saved in localStorage.

spec.goal: Have a playable Tetris game whose high score is saved in the browser's localStorage.
spec.deliverable: A working Tetris game that runs in the browser, with the high score stored in and read from localStorage.
constraints: The game must be Tetris, with the standard falling-piece gameplay.
The high score must be saved using localStorage.
The saved high score must be loaded again when the game is reopened.
No features beyond a Tetris game with a persistent high score are added.
done_criteria: The game is playable as Tetris: pieces fall, can be moved and rotated, and complete lines clear.
The current score is tracked during play.
When a game ends with a score above the stored high score, the new high score is written to localStorage.
After reloading the page, the previously saved high score is displayed.
spec.summary: You want a Tetris game that remembers your high score in the browser using localStorage.
